annotation_policy: Manual deterministic source-pixel samples on visible regulation painted court curves. Points were chosen only on clearly visible static court paint; player/ball/body pixels are forbidden. These curves were not used in the v26 eight-landmark metric fit and are held-out validation geometry.

notes.three_point_arc: Black NBA three-point curve. Samples avoid the occluded central player and the straight corner-three segments.
notes.free_throw_front_semicircle: Blue front half of the 6-foot free-throw circle. Only the clean centre/right segment is sampled because the left segment is partly occluded.
notes.purpose: Determine whether the four v26 floor anchors genuinely predict wider regulation court geometry before any metric camera is promoted.
